Exhibition name: Sungarden's Hospice
rows.Origin:
Bred by Ludwig Taschner (South Africa, before 2012).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2012 as 'Sungarden's Hospice'.
rows.Bloom: Golden-yellow and orange, ages to pink . Double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: up to 6'7" (up to 200cm). Width: up to 6'7" (up to 200cm).
